subject.title: [Feature]: Thread replies when agent uses tools; top-level for conversational responses

question: Should Slack add a default-off tool-use-sensitive reply-placement policy, and what precedence should it have relative to replyToMode, per-channel overrides, DMs/group DMs, existing threads, explicit top-level opt-outs, streaming previews, and status indicators?
rationale: Current source proves the feature is absent, but the proposed fix adds public Slack config and changes user-visible reply routing, so automation should not choose the permanent policy shape.

options.title: Approve a precise Slack policy
options.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then implement the Slack-owned schema, routing, docs, and regression tests with default false for compatibility.

options.title: Use static reply controls only
options.body: Keep account, chat-type, and per-channel replyToMode as the supported channel-cleanliness controls and close this feature after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Defer to broader channel policy
options.body: Hold the issue until maintainers design a cross-channel reply-placement policy instead of adding Slack-specific config now.

recommendation.title: Approve a precise Slack policy
recommendation.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then implement the Slack-owned schema, routing, docs, and regression tests with default false for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on adjacent Slack reply routing and thread-safety changes.
